targetMarket: India (INR ₹, +91 phone formatting, Indian gym operational context)
pricing: ₹999/month after 10-day free trial (No credit card required)

designSystem.themeConcept: Deep Navy / Obsidian Charcoal canvas paired with Kinetic Amber Blaze (#FF5A1F) and Volt Emerald (#10B981). High density, precision tactical borders, ultra-legible typography.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-snug
scale.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider

landingPage.navbar: Sticky header with backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 dark:bg-slate-900/80, brand logo with orange icon, links (Features, How It Works, Pricing, FAQ), and right-aligned 'Start Free Trial' + 'Login' CTAs.
landingPage.hero: Asymmetric hero section. Left: H1 'Run Your Gym on Autopilot', badge '₹999/mo after 10-day trial', bullets with green checkmarks, primary CTA button + Secondary demo button. Right: High-fidelity interactive mock dashboard preview with glow.
landingPage.featuresGrid: 3x3 bento grid with high-contrast icon tiles: Member Check-ins, Automated WhatsApp Alerts, Fee Due Management, Multi-branch/Outlets, Attendance Tracker, Trainer Commission, Reports & Analytics, Expense Logger, Custom Catalogue.
landingPage.howItWorks: 3-step visual stepper (1. Register Gym & Branches -> 2. Add Plans & Members -> 3. Collect Payments & Track Growth).
landingPage.pricing: Transparent single tier card highlighting ₹999/month, 10-day free trial, no credit card required, feature breakdown list.
landingPage.faq: Accordion component with clear questions on Indian payment modes (UPI/QR), WhatsApp integration, multi-branch, and data security.
landingPage.finalCta: Gradient contrast card inviting gym owners to start trial now.
landingPage.footer: Dark slate footer with legal info, copyright BuildVVO Technologies Private Limited, quick links.
landingPage.floatingWhatsapp: Pill button bottom-right with WhatsApp green badge (#25D366) and direct chat action.

authPages.login: Clean card layout with GymBoss_VVO branding, email/password input, forgot password link, light/dark toggle, and direct submit button.
authPages.registrationStepper: 3-step progress bar (Step 1: Account Info -> Step 2: Contact & Security -> Step 3: Gym Setup). Active step highlighted, completed steps marked green.
authPages.forgotPassword: Simple recovery request form with instant status toast confirmation.

appShell.sidebar: Fixed/collapsible dark sidebar with logo, navigation links (Dashboard, Members, Attendance, Plans, Payments, Enquiries, Expenses, Outlets, Staff, Reports, Settings), and trial timer widget ('10-Day Free Trial — X Days Left' with 'Upgrade Now' CTA).
appShell.topBar: Top bar containing outlet selector dropdown (e.g., 'Indiranagar Branch', 'HSR Layout Branch'), theme toggle (Light / Dark / System), search trigger, notifications trigger, and user profile avatar dropdown.
appShell.dashboard: Business operations layout: compact metric cards (Today's Collection in ₹, Admissions, Renewals, Due Payments, Active Enquiries, Total Active Members), quick action bar, and Recent Transactions compact table.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: All interactive elements and key data containers MUST have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='kpi-today-collection').
Do NOT use pure #000000 or plain gray-50 backgrounds; tint neutral dark colors with deep navy tone (#080D1A, #0F172A).
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for header menus or dropdown overlays.
Dashboard tables MUST be compact and density-focused with minimal vertical padding (e.g. py-2.5 px-3) for business operations clarity.
India-first currency formatting is mandatory: Always format currency using ₹ INR symbol with Indian numbering system (e.g., ₹1,25,000).
Phone numbers must follow Indian formatting (+91 98765 43210).
Use sonner for toast notifications across the application.
Ensure complete support for Light, Dark, and System theme switching in both app shell and dashboard.
